header: From install to client demo in four steps
subheadline: Each step is one command. Or skip the list and let the maintainers install Desiderio for you, for €890.

items.title: Install the package
items.description: Run composer require webconsulting/desiderio on TYPO3 v14.3 or later with PHP 8.4 or later. The GPL-2.0-or-later licence leaves nothing to negotiate.

items.title: Add the site set
items.description: Include the Desiderio site set. The theme settings for preset, dark mode, density, radius and fonts then appear in your site configuration.

items.title: Seed the styleguide
items.description: desiderio:styleguide:seed creates a complete demo site with all 244 elements. It works in workspaces and is safe to run again.

items.title: Choose your theme preset
items.description: Each styleguide chapter uses a different theme preset through the per-page override. Browse all 15 and choose yours.
